description:
FunctionSourceStash(f) is a revision tag on PendingFunctionSourceMap, a Vec<Option<FunctionSource>> the scope walk fills for every function it scopes. Job::PublishFunctionSource(f) copies that slot into FunctionState::Noted and publishes FunctionSource(f); every downstream job (ExpandFunctionSource, DefineFunction, ...) reads FunctionSource. Two stores of one value, and one job whose whole body is the copy. The laziness the comments defend does not need the tier: a FunctionSource fact is not body work, and lowering stays pulled by consumers.

Research 2026-09-16 (fz-wt-98-base at 549c3b05d). Production readers of pending_function_sources: two Placeholder fallbacks in world.rs (function_variadic ~1794, publish_pending_function_source ~3153) plus a cfg(test) function_scope; once the walk calls note_function_source directly the state is Noted and the existing Noted arms answer. Noted vs Defined is load-bearing and untouched (function_declares_contract, function_surface, identity.rs ~591 keeps Defined over a re-note). Telemetry: fz.compiler2.function.source.stashed is pinned at world_test.rs ~285, drive_test.rs ~4157 and ~18355; noted at drive_test.rs ~3786/~3840 and SourceNoteCapture. After the fold one event remains, noted, fired where stashed fires today; the noted pin's assertion text must be rewritten since the event now means scoped, not pulled. The terminal dangling case (home code not yet submitted): give FactKey::FunctionSource(f) a real arm in demand_fact_producer that runs demand_function_scope(f) and demands the producers of the facts it names; the terminal case then demands nothing, which is the honest answer, and the arm-less wait exception is deleted along with its paragraph. The same arm serves the two bare wait_on_current(FunctionSource(f)) sites in jobs/source.rs (define_function ~262, expand_function_source ~393).

Removed: FactKey::FunctionSourceStash; PendingFunctionSourceMap; World::pending_function_source, stash_function_source, publish_pending_function_source; Job::PublishFunctionSource, publish_function_source_job, its job_order_rank / semantic_cmp / jsonl arms and the FunctionSource -> PublishFunctionSource producer arm; the stashed telemetry event; the Placeholder stash fallbacks; the arm-less-wait exception. Added: a multi-fact arm for FunctionSource inside the existing demand_fact_producer. Census: one job start fewer per reached function; no pin may rise. Corpus canon byte-identical. Docs: fact-engine.md and pipeline.md mention the stash; rewrite as present-tense facts.

Built 2026-09-16 on 549c3b05d (patch parked in the session scratchpad as 226-ready.patch, 1448 lines): gate green, canon 548/548 identical, 00181 job starts 443 -> 409, json_roundtrip 4527 -> 4247, nine pin sites down; two pins on enum_take_drop_split want UP (rebased completions 80 -> 85, all DeriveInputDemand; DeriveStaticCallees(List.reduce/3) evaluations 273/140 -> 274/141, the extra run blocked on LoweredBody). Cause: FunctionSource(f) now exists one round earlier and is present-but-dirty while the walk that published it is blocked, where before it was absent; that is fz-kdt.228 layer 1 surfacing on FunctionSource. Decision (user, 2026-09-16): land fz-kdt.228 first, then this fold rebased on it, so no commit raises a pin; the two numbers are the acceptance signal.
title: Delete the function source stash tier: the scope walk publishes FunctionSource(f) directly
